Title: Siren's Lure vs. Unleash Hell's Fury (also Remover)

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
How does  Siren's Lure interact with a block attempt from  Unleash Hell's Fury ?

Is UHF tapped? (notice that it can't block, which would make it cease to be a minion, before it was tapped by the SL text)

Does it matter that  UHF is tapped, i.e. can it block while tapped?

What happens if  UHF is tapped by  Remover ? Can it still block?

Is there a comprehensive Siren's Lure interaction list/FAQ?
Here are all of LSJ's posts that include the term.

Messages.Author: jhattara
Messages.Body:
UHF can attempt to block even if it's tapped. www.vekn.net/index.php/forum/6-rules-questions/15007-what-about-a-tapped-unleash-hells-fury

Block denial works on UHF just as with any vampire. But as it's no longer a minion after it stops blocking the rest of the Siren's Lure's text is irrelevant.

Ah, that one went quite unnoticed... Thank you, wowlijetgold for bringing it back !

So, the general ruling is: You can't queue a combat if there is already one queued right after the current one.

This basically means:
- You can't play Psyche! if someone (usually the opponent) played Blissful Agony (unless you've dodged).
- You can, however, play Telepathic Tracking on Blissful Agony, as it doesn't create a new combat.
- You can't play Psyche! if someone (usually the opponent) played Illusions of the Kindred (unless you've dodged).

Now, Siren's Lure does queue a combat, but after the action's resolution. So we need to consider the following situations:

- Can I play two Siren's Lures on the same action? => No.  [LSJ 20020123]

- Can I play Psyche! during the action's resolution (and before the Siren's Lure combat) ? => Yes.  [LSJ 20090324]

- Can I play Psyche! after the Siren's Lure combat? => Yes.

- If I play Siren's Lure, and then am block, and in the resulting combat, play Form of Mist and continue the action, when does the Siren's Lure's combat start? => After the last resolution, and not as soon as the first resolution is reached. That is: You continue your action, and after it's successful / finally blocked, Siren's Lure kicks in. (this is probably a new ruling, but it stands there for coherence with the other rulings).

- Can I play sup' Form of Mist in the Siren's Lure combat? => Yes, but you won't be able to continue the action (Siren's Lure states we are now past resolution).
